title: KAITO — It's About The Particulars, No?〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hello! I'm here to have some coffee!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Welcome, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Welcome!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, are you helping out today?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yup. Miku and Luka are apparently out singing.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Rin, I'll prepare the coffee, so would you mind keeping KAITO company for me?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Your usual delicious brew, please.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I know.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, did you see Kohane after that?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? After when?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: When?! Remember how she asked us for advice regarding the track she's making?! She talked about how she based it off of An's song!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, since then?
I mean, it's only been a day or so since we last met.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. Also, she has to practice for that event, so visiting every day seems a bit difficult.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... Yeah, I guess so...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But I'm sure she'll stop by to have us listen to her song once she's finished working on the beat, no?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
We should just relax and wait patiently.
There's no point in us getting antsy, or putting pressure on her by going over to ask how she's doing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know...!
But I can't get it out of my head...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Aren't you the least bit curious, KAITO?
Don't you wanna know what kind of song she's writing?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Of course I am.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to hearing her song very much since she seems to have a clear idea of what she wants to do.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then, why does it seem like you don't really care...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? Because I'm imagining what it's going to be like?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I-Imagining what it's gonna be like?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. We got to hear what sort of sounds she sampling, as well as her overall image for her song.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I've been having fun imagining how Kohane's going to mix the ingredients she's gathered in her head and throwing in a few different beats. As a result, I've been able to come up with three possible patterns.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But how do you know what she's thinking?! Did you memorize every sound that she's using for her song?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I made an effort to remember as much as I could while I listened.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Rin, is something the matter...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's just... You're really amazing sometimes, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? What's this all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Because you remembered all those different sounds and came up with essentially three songs all in your head!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: How's that not amazing?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Umm... Have you forgotten that I'm a DJ?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, I haven't!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wait, you haven't?! And you're still this amazed?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's probably because she's never seen you take being a DJ seriously, no?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Anyway, here's your coffee.
I went with a slightly darker roast today.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, let's have a taste...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Mmm...!
Such a bold and deep flavor. I can feel it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Wait, no...!
As delicious as this coffee is, more importantly...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I have been taking being a DJ seriously lately.

rows.Speaker: Rin & MEIKO
rows.Line:
What are you talking about?
No, you haven't.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: At the very least, we sure haven't seen you doing so.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Guh... Wait, ask Len!
I've been a good teacher! Honest!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sure...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hmm... Okay, so...
Coming up with songs in your head isn't really a big deal for you, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: To be fair, I'm just imagining them.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's fairly common for those ideas to not turn out the way I want when turning them into actual sound.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Anyway, I stand by my original point.
We should wait patiently and give Kohane some time.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ahh... Another day and another cup of MEIKO's delicious coffee...
